title: Scott overhears Navajo men talk of the old crash site

tellings.quote: So I proed it a little bit and said, "You know what? What are you talking about crash site?" "Oh, it's an old wives tale. Who knows? UFO crashed out there. Late 40s, early 50s.

plain: In 1988 in Farmington, New Mexico, a man named Scott Ramsey says he overheard some Navajo men, from the Native American people of that region, talking about a "crash site." Ramsey says he pressed them on it and they told him, "Oh, it's an old wives tale. Who knows? UFO crashed out there. Late 40s, early 50s." He tells it as the first hint that led him toward a possible crash of an unknown craft in the area.
